summary.product_detail: 334 units across ten floor plans: 163 one-bedroom (720 SF), 159 two-bedroom (846-1,006 SF) and 12 three-bedroom (1,282-1,444 SF). Roughly 44% of units carry a renovated interior finish, denoted by the R suffix on the plan code.

summary.tax_rate_evidence: 2025 published Maricopa County rate for tax area code 031600, 9.6382 per $100 of assessed value, applied to the limited property value at Arizona's 15% commercial assessment ratio. Under Proposition 117 the limited value does not reset on sale, so a buyer inherits the seller's basis rather than being reassessed at the purchase price.

trade_out.absent_reason: A lease trade-out report exists in the data room but was deliberately excluded from this output set, so there is no basis for a new-versus-renewal trade-out block. The new-lease evidence on the unit-mix tab is derived from the rent roll's own lease dates instead.

comps.absent_reason: The operator's own weekly rent scrape holds 95 communities within three miles of the site, 92 of them multifamily, but no successful rent observation for any of them — the market has identity coverage only. Licensed comp feeds are excluded by design, so this block is empty rather than padded from another source.

demand.absent_reason: Ring demographics come from a separate service that was not run for this output set, so no population, household, income or jobs figures are reproduced here rather than estimated.
